title: Software Engineer, New Grad — Backend Platform
jd_text: We're hiring new-grad software engineers for our backend platform team. You'll build REST APIs in Java and Spring Boot, work with Kafka-based event pipelines and Elasticsearch for our order-processing microservices, and ship code through CI/CD on Kubernetes. Requirements: BS/MS in CS or related field, internship or up to 2 years of professional backend experience, familiarity with Java, Spring Boot, and distributed systems. This is a full-time new-grad role based in San Jose, CA (hybrid).

title: New Grad Software Engineer — AI Agents
jd_text: Arcline AI is looking for a new-grad backend engineer to join our agent platform team. You'll design and build Python/FastAPI services that integrate GPT-4o and other LLMs into structured agentic workflows: reasoning, tool-calling, and follow-up-action pipelines over large internal datasets. Ideal candidates have hands-on experience building LLM-powered applications (prompt engineering, structured-output parsing, agentic workflows) alongside solid backend fundamentals. Entry-level / new-grad, 0-2 years experience. Remote-US.

jd_text: Join our backend services team building internal platform APIs. Primary language is Java; services communicate over gRPC and Protobuf rather than REST, so prior gRPC experience is a plus. You'll also touch Kafka for event streaming. Entry-level position, 0-2 years of experience, degree in CS or related field required. Location: Austin, TX (onsite).
